brief:
Students across Gaza who have secured university places and scholarships abroad remain unable to leave the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. As a new academic term begins, dozens of qualified applicants face impossible immigration requirements and border restrictions that prevent their departure despite holding confirmed admissions and financial aid packages from universities overseas.

The students had competed for and won places at institutions outside Gaza through standard selection processes. Their inability to travel has forced many to defer enrollment, abandon educational opportunities they had secured, or miss critical deadlines set by their receiving universities. The situation leaves families uncertain whether the students will eventually reach their destinations or lose their places entirely.
dek: As a new term begins, students promised places abroad face impossible immigration rules.
title: Gaza students with overseas offers stuck by immigration barriers
